topic: Loki's killing of his own father Harald wasn't a betrayal of Elbaph, it was Elbaph's first war against Imu
title: Loki Didn't Betray Elbaph — He Started A War With Imu (1194)
description:
Elbaph still calls Loki the Accursed Prince for killing his own father. I think that's backwards. Harald was already following an order from Imu to build a giant army for the World Government, and I think Loki's patricide is what stopped it before it finished.

This breaks down chapters 1134 through 1194: the Abyss Circle, the fruit that cost Loki his father, and the hybrid dragon form now fighting Imu directly beside Luffy. Is Loki Elbaph's real hero, or just its best-kept secret?
comment: Is Loki the real hero of Elbaph, or did he just get lucky that his crime lined up with the kingdom's survival?
